_comment: TOG-24386 stage 1: org SDLC baseline ruleset, EVALUATE (advisory). Requires ci-ok + pr-lint by stable name on main across ALL repos except the injected exclude list; requires PR thread resolution. The Operator injects excludes from sdlc-foundation/repo-exclude-list.txt (runbook step 1), fills no other placeholder, creates it with the runbook commands, then flips to sdlc-baseline-active.json. Deliberately absent: merge queue (verified 2026-10-15: org-rules schema excludes the merge-queue rule type, HTTP 422 — stage 3 is the merge_queue_ready property + shared reconciler, TOG-24376) and Paperclip Review (requested only on ready heads after ci-ok green, TOG-19598 trigger). Reserved names for sibling tracks — required only when their producers exist, via the rename-trap procedure: size-label (TOG-24377), squawk-pg-lint (TOG-24379), test-missing (TOG-24380), security-scan (TOG-24381).
name: sdlc-baseline
